verdict.rationale: Alloy is a KYC/AML and fraud decisioning platform, so adverse-media review is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions adverse-media screening, match review, linked source evidence or risk categorization. Mentions of AML checks, watchlist updates and manual review are adjacent at best and do not document this capability.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can review adverse-media matches with linked evidence and risk categories
